title: Dei Delitti e delle pene
author: Cesare Beccaria
current_text: In 1766, Dei Delitti e delle pene was added to the Index Librorum Prohibitorum.

sources.quote: Beccaria at first published his work anonymously, only adding his name once it was accepted by government censors, but two years after publication in 1766 De delitti e delle pene was added to the Index Librorum Prohibitorum.
sources.title: Dei Delitti e Delle Pene - The Index Librorum Prohibitorum and the Censorship of Law Books - Tarlton Law Library at Tarlton Law Library
